description: Bern Minster closes Münsterplatz with one Gothic sandstone tower, rectangular below and octagonal above, and an openwork spire. Three portals face the square, and flying buttresses run along the nave. No scaffolding is shown, and the windows stay dark. This replaces the Zytglogge, already published. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 10°C, with full cloud cover, very humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
